Data Scientist — Machine Learning Platform
Company: DataVerse Analytics
Location: New York, NY (Remote-friendly)
Type: Full-time

About the Role:
We are hiring a Data Scientist to join our ML Platform team. You will build production-grade machine learning models, design experiments, and translate business problems into data-driven solutions.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models for production use cases
- Design and implement A/B testing frameworks and experimental designs
- Build data pipelines using Apache Spark and Airflow
- Create dashboards and visualizations for stakeholder communication
- Perform statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
- Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models via REST APIs
- Write clean, well-documented Python code for model development
- Conduct exploratory data analysis on large-scale datasets

Required Skills:
- 3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning
- Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
- Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Strong foundation in statistics and probability
- Experience with SQL and relational databases
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
- Knowledge of ML model deployment and serving (MLflow, SageMaker, or similar)
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with Apache Spark and distributed computing
- Knowledge of NLP or computer vision
- Experience with experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases)
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
- Published research or Kaggle competition experience
